name: NetworksDB.io (organisation, IP and network registry search, keyed)
tier_rationale: Small identifiable operator with public API documentation and plans (P218 chair rationale: 'NetworksDB is a small identifiable operator: tier community').

reliability.justification: Registry (WHOIS) derived ranges, but the organisation search is fuzzy: ranges stay candidates until RDAP (P003) or NIC.br (P038) confirm them (P218 FC3).

error_markers.reason: NetworksDB: error object in an HTTP 200 body

networksdb.description: NetworksDB.io API key (sent only in the X-Api-Key header, never as the apikey parameter)
networksdb.plan_hint: business = a company/team NetworksDB account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (P218 FC2)

api.title: NetworksDB.io API (org-search, org-networks, ip-info; X-Api-Key header): organisation -> IP ranges, IP -> owner network

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal before it runs under corporate. Monthly quota through the P334 block.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P218 FC2). No key: HTTP 400 {error:'required header `X-Api-Key` or query parameter `apikey` missing'} -> NEEDS_KEY (FC1). Free keys: 1,000 requests/month, page 1 only. The flow (org-search -> org-networks) is re-implemented from the vendor documentation; no corptrace (AGPL) code is used (FC4). org-info address/phone fields are never read.
